summary: Phase 3: visuospatial cues + distance axis. Replaced the Phase 1/2 text cue with 8 SVG pictograph components (one per cue id) sourced from a data-driven CUE_PALETTE map so adding a new cue is purely additive (palette entry + library entry, no engine change). Each pictograph has its own CSS-keyframe animation. Added a Distance type (far/mid/in_range), per-cue byDistance rule table on the library, and engine helpers pickDistance + resolveCueAtDistance. classifyRep now takes isGo directly so the distance-resolved value drives classification. Reaction time is now rounded at the engine boundary (Math.round in classifyRep) — single source of truth. Three new Settings → Visuals toggles: distance axis on/off, distance audio tone on/off, text label overlay on/off. CueStage renders the pictograph at far=0.45, mid=0.7, in_range=1.0 scale and optionally shows the text overlay. Optional Web Audio oscillator tone (220/440/660 Hz per distance) with graceful no-op when AudioContext is unavailable. 13 new tests added (60 total, all green): pickDistance distribution + membership, resolveCueAtDistance with table / null / flat-cue, pickNextCue distance-axis (uniform across library, ignores goCueProbability), session distance stamping (axis on vs off), palette ↔ library bijection, byDistance presence on every cue, audio module graceful degradation under missing AudioContext.

acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C1 — observed 8/8 distinct cue ids across reps; pictographs animate via CSS keyframes (anim-step-in, anim-blitz, anim-leg-lift, anim-hand-drop, anim-retreat, anim-freeze, anim-fake-step, anim-bait); palette.test.ts enforces palette↔library bijection

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Text labels render only as an optional learning overlay
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C2 — overlay OFF by default (pictograph only); toggling Visuals → 'Show text label overlay' surfaces the .cue-overlay element with the cue label

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Silhouette renders at three distance sizes: far / mid / in-range
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C3 — inline transform measured exactly 0.45 / 0.70 / 1.00 for far / mid / in_range

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Drill profiles can enable the distance axis (same cue at different ranges → different responses)
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C4 — 35 no-press reps with distance axis on; 7 'far' reps on otherwise-go cues resolved to correct_no_go (HOLD ✓); resolveCueAtDistance unit-tested across all three distance entries + null fallback + flat-cue fallback

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Optional continuous audio tone whose pitch tracks current rendered distance
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C5 — tone enabled, drill ran cleanly, window.AudioContext present, zero audio-related console errors; audio/distanceTone.test.ts asserts graceful no-op when AudioContext is undefined or throws on construction

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cue palette and animations are data-driven (JSON or TS map)
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qa-playwright C6 — 8/8 distinct cue ids observed via SVG class names; cues/palette.ts is a Record<CueId, PaletteEntry>; palette.test.ts enforces palette↔library coverage; adding a new cue requires no engine change (library entry + palette entry + pictograph component)

gates.testing: 60/60 vitest tests pass (was 47 at Phase 2 boundary; 13 new tests added). Every new public behavior has a primary-path test plus at least one edge case: pickDistance (distribution + membership), resolveCueAtDistance (axis-on, axis-off, flat-cue fallback), pickNextCue distance-on (full library, ignores prob), session distance stamping (on vs off), audio graceful degradation (no AudioContext, throwing AudioContext), palette ↔ library bijection.
gates.dry: Distance-conditional rule lives only in resolveCueAtDistance. Pictograph BaseFigure factors the common stickman skeleton across the 5 cues that use it (3 cues inline the body to animate sub-elements — small fragment duplication, called out by reviewer as acceptable). reactionMs is rounded in exactly one place (classifyRep); the redundant Math.round in TrainerScreen was removed during review.
gates.drift: Phase 1/2 patterns extended cleanly. SummaryScreen and IdleScreen do not yet show distance per rep — code-reviewer confirmed Phase 4 explicitly owns 'per-cue-type RT and error-rate breakdown' so this is deferred, not drift. RepRecord.distance is optional so Phase 1/2 stored reps still load.
gates.planning: decision-memo.md rewritten for Phase 3; planning gate triggered by cross-layer change (engine + cue lib + UI + audio module) and the new rule table for distance-axis classification.
gates.verification_sprint: Re-ran lint + tsc + 47/47 tests at the Phase 2 boundary before any Phase 3 code was added — all green. qa-playwright Phase 2 regression also passed (HUD, rest screen, summary, recent sessions list).
gates.pre_commit_verify: scripts/phasekit-verify.sh runs lint + typecheck + tests; gate intact since Phase 1.

review.code_reviewer: APPROVE — no blocking issues. 7 non-blocking nits raised; 3 applied (removed redundant Math.round in TrainerScreen; added test that distance-axis-on ignores goCueProbability; added audio-module graceful-degradation tests). 4 deferred (React import nit, audio singleton-factory refactor, BaseFigure render-prop refactor, cached resolveCueAtDistance — all premature optimizations for Phase 3).
review.qa_playwright: PASS — all 6 Phase 3 acceptance criteria + Phase 2 regression verified. 8/8 distinct cue pictographs observed. Three distance scales measured exactly. Zero console errors and zero failed network requests across the entire run. Evidence in app/artifacts/phase3-verify/.
